name: Types
overview: Scripture reveals the profound use of types to foreshadow Christ and His redemptive work, as seen in the mercy seat made of pure gold (Exodus 25:17) and the altar constructed of shittim wood (Exodus 27:1), which point to the sanctuary and its services. The narrative of Noah, whose name means comfort, serves as a type of salvation through the gospel (Genesis 5:29). These examples demonstrate that God ordained tangible symbols and historical events to prefigure spiritual realities centered on Christ and His mediatorship.
